title: Richard Doty's father involved in Area 51 and UFOs

tellings.quote: His own father was uh I don't know all the details but was deeply involved in Area 51 and with UFOs.
I think his father worked at Area 51. Are you familiar with that history? Dolan told me that.
tellings.difference: Told by the host second hand from Dolan, and leaves out the father's UFO involvement.
tellings.link_reason: Both say Doty's father worked at Area 51, and the host credits Dolan, who tells the existing story.

plain: The father of a man named Richard Doty was "deeply involved in Area 51 and with UFOs", Area 51 being a secret US military test site in Nevada, according to the researcher Richard Dolan, who says he got this from Doty but admits he does not know all the details. Michels later repeats it to another guest, the writer Greg Bishop, saying only that Doty's father worked at Area 51 and that Dolan told him so. If true, it would mean Doty's ties to secret UFO matters went back to his own family.
